action_instruction: Typing 0 into Fee per side field
intent: PRIMARY: In the Account panel, clear the "Fee per side" field and type 0; role=textbox; text="Fee per side" | HINTS: container=Account panel
rationale: The Account panel shows the Fee per side input with the current value 0.05.

action_instruction: Reading the closed trade realized P&L from the Journal
intent: the realized P&L value for the closed trade in the Journal

action_params.condition: The same closed trade in the Journal shows a realized P&L of +$187.59.
action_params.query: the realized P&L value for the closed trade in the Journal

action_instruction: Reading the closed trade R multiple from the Journal
intent: the R multiple value for the closed trade in the Journal

action_params.condition: The same closed trade in the Journal shows an R multiple of +1.88R.
action_params.query: the R multiple value for the closed trade in the Journal

assertion_tree.description: the same closed trade in the Journal still shows a realized P&L of +$187.59 and an R multiple of +1.88R

sub_results.description: The same closed trade in the Journal shows a realized P&L of +$187.59.
The same closed trade in the Journal shows an R multiple of +1.88R.

assertion_tree.verification: The same closed trade in the Journal shows the specified realized P&L and R multiple.
